alcohol.answer: China Southern bans alcohol in carry-on unless you bought it in the terminal's sterile area after security. In checked baggage, drinks up to 24% alcohol are unrestricted, drinks above 24% and up to 70% are limited to 5 litres net per person, and anything above 70% is not accepted.

sections.h: 🍷 What China Southern says about alcohol
sections.p: From the China Southern General Conditions of Carriage for Passenger and Baggage (sections 4.5.6, 6.2.9 and 6.3.4.7), read on 22 November 2026. Cabin liquids are covered by its separate carry-on liquids rule.

head: Question
China Southern rule
rows: Prohibited, except alcohol bought in the sterile area of the terminal, which may go on board if it meets the carry-on and alcohol rules
No more than 5 litres net per person
Must meet civil aviation transport rules
Not allowed aboard; only alcohol provided by China Southern may be drunk

list: Not on the page: the Conditions do not say what happens to duty-free alcohol bought at an overseas airport; the carry-on FAQ says China Southern follows local regulations for those liquids.

faq: Can I bring a bottle of alcohol in my China Southern carry-on?
Not unless you bought it in the sterile area of the terminal after security. Alcohol from elsewhere goes in checked baggage.
How much alcohol can I check on China Southern?
Up to 24% alcohol is unrestricted; above 24% and up to 70% is limited to 5 litres net per person; above 70% is not accepted.
Can I drink my own alcohol on a China Southern flight?
No. Passengers may drink only the alcohol China Southern provides on board.
sources: China Southern — General Conditions of Carriage for Passenger & Baggage
